Interview process
We’ve designed our process with you in mind. This is as much an opportunity for you to make sure CTI Digital is right for you as you are for us.

📞 Screening Stage - A 30-minute exploratory call with our Talent Team.
💻 1st Stage - Video call with our Head of Sales. A chance to explore the role and responsibilities.
📆 2nd Stage - A face-to-face interview with one our our Sales Directors and the Head of Sales. We’ll probe around your commercial experience and approach to client relationships.
🎉 Offer - If we think it’s a good fit, we’ll make you an offer!
data.description:
About CTI

Join 150+ strategists and specialists who refuse to settle, creating bold digital experiences for ambitious brands since 2004. We're a full-service digital agency delivering strategic consultancy, web development, and digital marketing to drive demand online. Using over two decades of industry experience, we provide next-gen solutions as part of lasting partnerships with hundreds of clients from Chester Zoo and Zip World to Balfour Beatty and Mind.
data.key_responsibilities: You'll be responsible for building and maintaining a healthy top of the sales funnel by proactively identifying, engaging and qualifying new business opportunities. Working closely with Business Development Managers and the wider Commercial team, you'll generate high-quality meetings through outbound prospecting, account research, networking and targeted outreach. This role is focused on creating a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities that progress into strategy sessions, audits and ultimately larger implementation projects and long-term client relationships.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
We're looking for someone with a proven track record in outbound sales who's ready to own their pipeline and make a measurable impact on CTI's growth

Key qualities include:
  • Sales development experience: Proven experience in Sales Development, Business Development or Lead Generation, ideally within a digital agency, technology or SaaS environment.
  • Outbound prospecting skills: Strong ability to engage prospects across phone, email, LinkedIn and networking, with confidence to reach and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Qualification and discovery: Demonstrated skill in identifying genuine commercial opportunities through structured qualification conversations and thorough account research.
  • CRM and data proficiency: Experience using CRM platforms (preferably HubSpot) to manage pipeline and activity, with a data-driven mindset for tracking KPIs and performance metrics.
  • Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, including personalised outreach and follow-up that cuts through the noise.
  • Resilience and self-motivation: Comfortable working towards activity and pipeline targets, staying focused and positive through the inevitable challenges of outbound sales.
We’re challenging the 'Gender Confidence Gap,' which suggests that individuals will only apply for a job if they meet 100% of the criteria. Some of our best hires didn’t check every box in the role description, so if you were about to rule yourself out, we still encourage you to apply!

data.key_responsibilities:
As the Head of Organic at CTI Digital, you’ll be the visionary leading our SEO department. You'll define and scale our agency offerings across Technical SEO, Content, and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO). You'll bridge the gap between technical architecture and commercial success, ensuring our clients stay at the forefront of Search.

Key Responsibilities:
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
To succeed in this role, you’ll need a mix of commercial acumen, technical mastery, and strong leadership skills. You should be someone who loves the mechanics of search but never loses sight of the bigger business picture.

Key qualities include:
  • Organic expertise: Deep knowledge of Technical SEO, Content strategy, and the rapidly evolving landscape of Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
  • Commercial acumen: Proven experience in managing a P&L, with a track record of translating organic performance into demonstrable business impact.
  • Technical fluency: A solid understanding of site architecture, CMS platforms, and e-commerce builds, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers.
  • Forward-thinking: Experience or a strong interest in leveraging automation and agentic workflows to streamline operations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: A history of working alongside diverse marketing and tech teams to build holistic strategies.
  • Leadership: Experience leading, mentoring, and scaling a team of specialists, bringing out the best in everyone.
  • Clear communication: The ability to simplify complex concepts for stakeholders and confidently present insights via webinars or thought leadership pieces.
